text: {"lessons":["My account rose while I made no trades, but a short run of gains does not prove that doing nothing caused them or predict what comes next.","Because losses bother me more than equal gains please me, I should avoid letting fear of a loss drive a rushed decision; assess each holding calmly.","I check my account infrequently and trade rarely, so I should make deliberate decisions based on my overall goals rather than react to ordinary price changes."]}
